This feature isn't available if you received an email with the subject [Billing Update] New Gemini Enterprise overage billing controls launching Aug 17, 2026. In Gemini Enterprise, your subscription entitles your users to specific feature quotas. When your project reaches its pooled quota for a feature, feature usage stops unless you enable overages. How overages work depends on your product edition: Product edition Overages support Gemini Enterprise Standard, Plus, and Standard Emerging Market Supported. You can enable overages to let users exceed included quotas at pay-as-you-go rates. For more information about how pooled quotas work, see Quotas and overages. Overages and spend controls are available only if your project has an invoiced Cloud Billing account and at least one active, non-free-trial subscription. To verify your account type, see Find out your Cloud Billing account type and charging cycle. Gemini Enterprise Pay-as-you-go Not applicable. You pay for all usage on a pay-as-you-go basis without pooled quota limits. Note: Gemini Enterprise Standard Emerging Market edition is available only to eligible customers. Contact your Google account team to assess the requirements and determine your eligibility. For more information, see the following resources: View feature usage Configure overages Cap costs with a project spend limit To prevent unexpected charges when you enable overages, you can configure a monthly spend limit on your total spend in Cloud Billing. When defining a budget for your project, you select Vertex AI (aiplatform.googleapis.com) as the service scope. This sets a project-level spend cap that applies across all of the following areas: Gemini Enterprise app Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform AI coding and developer tools (such as Antigravity) When your project reaches this spend limit, overage usage is automatically stopped. To configure a monthly spend limit for your project, see Set a monthly spend limit. Note: Because stopping usage can take a few minutes to take effect, you might incur charges that exceed your limit. End-user experience when limits are reached When your project reaches a usage or spending limit, Gemini Enterprise restricts further usage. Feature access resumes automatically when the quota resets or at the start of the next billing cycle. Gemini Enterprise app displays the Usage limit reached error message when you chat with the assistant or use Gemini Enterprise features in either of the following scenarios: Your project reached its monthly spend cap. Your project exceeds its pooled quota limit for a specific feature and your Gemini Enterprise administrator hasn't enabled overages. This error affects only the feature that reached its limit. You can continue using other features that have remaining quota. Budget alert notifications The Gemini Enterprise app doesn't send automated email alerts or push notifications when your project reaches its pooled feature quotas or starts incurring overage charges. When your project reaches a pooled quota and you haven't enabled overages, end users see the Usage limit reached error message in the app. When you configure a monthly spend limit in Cloud Billing, you can set alert threshold rules to monitor your costs. Cloud Billing automatically sends email notifications when your spend reaches specified percentages of your budget, such as 50%, 80%, and 100% of the budget amount. The following principals receive budget alert notifications: Default recipients: Cloud Billing sends email alerts to users who have the Billing Account Administrator or Billing Account User IAM roles on the target billing account. Custom recipients: You can configure custom email recipients, such as specific project administrators, team distribution lists, or Pub/Sub channels, in your budget alert rules. If you need to permanently add more users to your subscription, the method and seat limits depend on your Google Cloud Billing account type
*   **Self-serve (Online) / Resold Accounts:** You can manage and purchase up to a maximum of **25 seats** directly through the Google Cloud console
*   **Invoiced (Offline) Accounts:** You can manage and purchase up to a maximum of **1,000 seats** directly through the Google Cloud console
** If you reach these seat-quantity caps or originally purchased your subscription via an offline order, you cannot add seats via the console
You must contact your Google Cloud Sales representative or account manager to modify your order and add more licenses
*⚠️ **Important Note on Reductions:** While you can increase your license count at any time, you **cannot** decrease your license count during an active subscription term
Reductions can only be made when the subscription term ends or is up for renewal

Exceeding Your Included Pooled Quotas (Overage Costs)
Instead of forcing you to purchase a brand-new seat the moment your team hits a resource limit, Gemini Enterprise allows you to handle temporary surges in activity through **Overage Billing**
If your team exceeds the combined, pooled quota of your purchased seats (e.g., total allowed daily assistant queries or storage), you have two options

**Keep Overages Disabled (Default):** Once the project's pooled quota is fully depleted, the affected feature stops working for all users, displaying a *"Usage limit reached"* message until the daily or weekly reset
No extra fees are charged
**Enable Overages:** Administrators can toggle on overages in the Google Cloud console, allowing users to continue using the assistant seamlessly
Excess usage is billed at **pay-as-you-go (consumption) rates**

Safeguard Against Runaway Overage Costs
To ensure that enabling overages does not lead to unexpected charges, Gemini Enterprise administrators can enforce a **Project Monthly Spend Limit**:
*   **The Spend Cap:** Administrators can set a hard budget cap in Cloud Billing

*   **The Scope:** Because Gemini Enterprise overages are processed under the Vertex AI API, you must select **Vertex AI (`aiplatform.googleapis.com`)** as the service scope when setting the budget limit
*   **Automatic Pause:** Once your overage spending hits 100% of this budget, Gemini Enterprise automatically pauses overage access until the next billing cycle
